analyzed: siddham namaḥ ratnatrayāya

original: [1.1] atha bhagavān vārāṇasyāṃ mahānagaryāṃ viharati sma | mahatārthakaraṇena sattvānāṃ dharmaṃ deśayati sma | yad uta sarvāśāmanorathaparipūrṇakalyāṇakārakam | mahatā parṣatsaṃnipāte takṣakapūrvaṃgamanāgarājaparṣadā | mahatā devamānuṣaparṣadā |
analyzed: atha bhagavān vārāṇasyām mahā nagaryām viharati sma mahatā artha karaṇena sattvānām dharmam deśayati sma yat uta sarva āśā manoratha paripūrṇa kalyāṇa kārakam mahatā parṣad saṃnipāte takṣaka pūrvaṃgama nāga rāja parṣadā mahatā deva mānuṣa parṣadā

original: [1.2] atha navanagare viṣṇudatto nāma brāhmaṇa āḍhyo mahādhano mahābhogaḥ prabhūtavittopakaraṇasaṃpanno vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ | mantrapravartako mantrasādhakaḥ | sa punaḥ punar nāgān āvāhayanti | agnihotraṃ juhoti | tasya brāhmaṇasya sasyakāle udakakṣayamati prādurabhūt | sa cāhaṃkāraśabdena mantrapadānumatena evaṃ kathayati | varṣadhārā-m-
analyzed: atha nava nagare viṣṇudattaḥ nāma brāhmaṇaḥ āḍhyaḥ mahādhanaḥ mahā bhogaḥ prabhūta vitta upakaraṇa saṃpannaḥ veda vedāṅga pāragaḥ mantra pravartakaḥ mantra sādhakaḥ sa punar punar nāgān āvāhayanti agnihotram juhoti tasya brāhmaṇasya sasya kāle udaka kṣayam ati prādurabhūt sa ca ahaṃkāra śabdena mantra pada anumatena evam kathayati varṣa dhārām

original: utsṛjāmy aham | nāgān āvāhayiṣyāmi | tenāgnihotraṃ prajñaptaṃ tilataṇḍulasarṣapakaṭutailābhyaktaṃ juhoti | tena kasyacid duṣṭanāgasya pratikṛtirūpaṃ kṛtam | tenāyomayaṃ kīlakaṃ parijapya tatas tasya nāgasya mūrdhni dattam | sa ca nāgo mūrdhānaṃ sphuṭati | mahatīṃ vedanām anubhavati | sa ca nāgo mahatā krodhena kruddhataraḥ | tataḥ
analyzed: utsṛjāmi aham nāgān āvāhayiṣyāmi tena agnihotram prajñaptam tila taṇḍula sarṣapa kaṭu taila abhyaktam juhoti tena kasyacid duṣṭa nāgasya pratikṛti rūpam kṛtam tena ayaḥ mayam kīlakam parijapya tatas tasya nāgasya mūrdhni dattam sa ca nāgaḥ mūrdhānam sphuṭati mahatīm vedanām anubhavati sa ca nāgaḥ mahatā krodhena kruddhataraḥ tatas

original: kṣaṇalavamuhūrtena svaśarīraṃ nāgaplavanavegena mahāpīḍānvitaḥ | tatas tai raśmayo svaśarīrād utsṛṣṭās tena tasya brāhmaṇasya kṣetrāṇi dagdhāni mahāpīḍena saṃchādya tasya mahatī agnivarṣadhārā brāhmaṇasya śarīre nipātitā | sa ca brāhmaṇa agnihotrāṇy utsṛjya atrāṇo aśaraṇa aparāyaṇo na kaścit trātāsti |
analyzed: kṣaṇa lava muhūrtena sva śarīram nāga plavana vegena mahāpīḍa anvitaḥ tatas taiḥ raśmayaḥ sva śarīrāt utsṛṣṭāḥ tena tasya brāhmaṇasya kṣetrāṇi dagdhāni mahāpīḍena saṃchādya tasya mahatī agni varṣa dhārā brāhmaṇasya śarīre nipātitā sa ca brāhmaṇa agnihotrāṇi utsṛjya atrāṇaḥ aśaraṇa aparāyaṇaḥ na kaścid trātā asti

original: sa ca bhagavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ trāṇaṃ parāyaṇaṃ gaveṣya vipralāpaṃ kartum ārabdhaḥ | bhagavato ’ntikam anudhāvati | yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrānto bhagavataḥ pādayor nipatyaivam āha | trāyatu bhagavān trāyatu sugataḥ | †catuṣugata† caṇḍanāgo mama jīvitavināśaṃ kartukāmo na kaścit trātāsti |
analyzed: sa ca bhagavantam śaraṇam trāṇam parāyaṇam gaveṣya vipralāpam kartum ārabdhaḥ bhagavataḥ ntikam anudhāvati yena bhagavān tena upasaṃkrāntaḥ bhagavataḥ pādayoḥ nipatya evam āha trāyatu bhagavān trāyatu sugataḥ catuṣugata caṇḍa nāgaḥ mama jīvita vināśam kartu kāmaḥ na kaścid trātā asti

original: [1.3] atha bhagavāṃs taṃ mahābrāhmaṇaṃ samāśvāsyaivam āha | mā bhayaṃ hi mahābrāhmaṇa ahaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatiḥ parāyaṇaṃ bhaviṣyāmīti | tūṣṇīm āsthitaḥ |
analyzed: atha bhagavān tam mahābrāhmaṇam samāśvāsya evam āha mā bhayam hi mahābrāhmaṇa aham te śaraṇam gatiḥ parāyaṇam bhaviṣyāmi iti tūṣṇīm āsthitaḥ

original: [1.4] atha khalu vajrapāṇir mahāyakṣasenāpatir bhagavantam etad avocat | paśya bhagavan pratyakṣībhāvena duṣṭanāgena sarvasasyāni vināśitāni | tat kathaṃ paścime kāle paścime samaye tvayi nirvṛte sarvasattvānāṃ gatiḥ syād iti | tad bhagavān bhāṣantu atha sasyaparipālanam | nāganivāraṇaṃ sarvasasyārtham | sarvasasyāni samarpitāni bhaviṣyanti |
analyzed: atha khalu vajrapāṇiḥ mahā yakṣa senāpatiḥ bhagavantam etat avocat paśya bhagavan pratyakṣībhāvena duṣṭa nāgena sarva sasyāni vināśitāni tat katham paścime kāle paścime samaye tvayi nirvṛte sarva sattvānām gatiḥ syāt iti tat bhagavān bhāṣantu atha sasya paripālanam nāga nivāraṇam sarva sasya artham sarva sasyāni samarpitāni bhaviṣyanti

original: saṃrakṣitāni pravardhitāni bhaviṣyanti |
analyzed: saṃrakṣitāni pravardhitāni bhaviṣyanti

original: [1.5] atha bhagavān vajrapāṇiṃ guhyakādhipatim etad avocat | asti vajrapāṇe nāgapratisarikāvagṛhītavajrā nāma dhāraṇī tathāgatahṛdayamudrā pūrvakais tathāgatair arhadbhiḥ saṃyaksaṃbuddhair bhāṣitā | aham apy etarhi bhāṣiṣye | yena śīghraṃ pīḍāpratiṣedhanārthāya sarvasasyapratipālanaṃ bhaviṣyati | svārakṣitāni bhaviṣyanti |
analyzed: atha bhagavān vajrapāṇim guhyaka adhipatim etat avocat asti vajrapāṇe nāgapratisarikā avagṛhītavajrā nāma dhāraṇī tathāgata hṛdaya mudrā pūrvakaiḥ tathāgataiḥ arhadbhiḥ saṃyak saṃbuddhaiḥ bhāṣitā aham api etarhi bhāṣiṣye yena śīghram pīḍā pratiṣedhana arthāya sarva sasya pratipālanam bhaviṣyati sva ārakṣitāni bhaviṣyanti

original: sarvanāgānāṃ sīmābandho bhaviṣyati | mahāgniparvataprāgbhārāḥ samantena caturdiśaṃ mahāgnijvālāpaṭalameghagaruḍavegapakṣivijṛmbhitaṃ nāmātra paṭalam ākāśaṃ saṃchādayanti | sarvapuṣpaphalasaṃrakṣaṇāya tiṣṭhati | yena sarvanāgādayaḥ saṃprajvalitā bhaviṣyanti | sarvaduṣṭanāgā vinaśyanti |
analyzed: sarva nāgānām sīmābandhaḥ bhaviṣyati mahā agni parvata prāgbhārāḥ samantena caturdiśam mahā agni jvālā paṭala meghagaruḍavegapakṣivijṛmbhitam nāma atra paṭalam ākāśam saṃchādayanti sarva puṣpa phala saṃrakṣaṇāya tiṣṭhati yena sarva nāga ādayaḥ saṃprajvalitāḥ bhaviṣyanti sarva duṣṭa nāgāḥ vinaśyanti

original: [1.6] atha vajrapāṇir mahāyakṣasenāpatir bhagavantam etad avocat | nirdiśatu bhagavān mahādhāraṇīmantrapadaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ hitaṃ kuru iti |
analyzed: atha vajrapāṇiḥ mahā yakṣa senāpatiḥ bhagavantam etat avocat nirdiśatu bhagavān mahā dhāraṇī mantra padam sarva sattvānām hitam kuru iti

original: [1.7] atha bhagavān idaṃ hṛdayaṃ bhāṣate sma |
analyzed: atha bhagavān idam hṛdayam bhāṣate sma

original: namo bhagavate buddhānām | namo bhagavate śākyamunirājāya | oṃ jvala jvala giri bhavanaṃ dīptavega mahācaṇḍahṛdayasphālani | huru huru hana hana daha daha paca paca pācaya sarvasasyanāśakanāgakulavaṃśam | dhara dhara pravaracaṇḍavega mahābalaparākrama sphūrjitaraudravaktra |
analyzed: namaḥ bhagavate buddhānām namaḥ bhagavate śākyamuni rājāya om jvala jvala giri bhavanam dīpta vega mahā caṇḍa hṛdaya sphālani huru huru hana hana daha daha paca paca pācaya sarva sasya nāśaka nāga kula vaṃśam dhara dhara pravara caṇḍa vega mahā bala parākrama sphūrjita raudra vaktra

original: matha matha jvālāmālādhāriṇi caṇḍavegavati pravaravimānadhāraṇi hūṃ hūṃ balavati vegavati visara visara visaranti sarvasasyatṛṇagulmoṣadhivanaspatipuṣpaphalapatrasaṃdhāraṇi | apasarantu sarvanāgadoṣāḥ | sarvabhavanavigatavegavati svāhā | hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ | nāgavidāriṇi phaṭ | jvālāmālini phaṭ svāhā |
analyzed: matha matha jvālā mālā dhāriṇi caṇḍa vegavati pravara vimāna dhāraṇi hūm hūm balavati vegavati visara visara visaranti sarva sasya tṛṇa gulma uṣadhi vanaspati puṣpa phala patra saṃdhāraṇi apasarantu sarva nāga doṣāḥ sarva bhavana vigata vegavati svāhā hūm hūm phaṭ nāga vidāriṇi phaṭ jvālā mālini phaṭ svāhā

original: [1.8] samanantarabhāṣitā bhagavatā iyaṃ vidyā sarvanāgasarvaduṣṭopadravanāśakā | mahānāgāḥ sarve śīrṣarogāḥ samvṛttāḥ | klinnakāyā durgandhapūtikakāyāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ | bhagavataḥ pādayor
analyzed: samanantara bhāṣitā bhagavatā iyam vidyā sarva nāga sarva duṣṭa upadrava nāśakāḥ mahā nāgāḥ sarve śīrṣa rogāḥ samvṛttāḥ klinna kāyāḥ durgandha pūtika kāyāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ bhagavataḥ pādayoḥ

original: nipatyaivam āhuḥ | atidāruṇāni bhagavan mantrapadāni bhāṣitāni | mama bhagavann aparādhaṃ jānīte | api tu bhagavan duṣṭavidyādhareṇāhaṃ paribhūyāmi | tāḍayāmi visarjayāmi | tadā bhagavan duṣṭanāgāḥ kṣubhanti | tadā sasyāni nāśayanti | puṣpaphalāni nāśayanti | aśaniṃ pātayanti | śītavātān
analyzed: nipatya evam āhuḥ ati dāruṇāni bhagavat mantra padāni bhāṣitāni mama bhagavan aparādham jānīte api tu bhagavan duṣṭa vidyādhareṇa aham paribhūyāmi tāḍayāmi visarjayāmi tadā bhagavan duṣṭa nāgāḥ kṣubhanti tadā sasyāni nāśayanti puṣpa phalāni nāśayanti aśanim pātayanti śīta vātān

original: saṃkṣobhayanti | ativṛṣṭim anāvṛṣṭim akālavṛṣṭiṃ pātayanti | api tu bhagavan maitrīvihāriṇā vidyādhareṇa mantravādinā bhavitavyam | maitrīsattvasaṃnāhena bhavitavyam | maitrīkhaḍgahastena bhavitavyam | maitryā sarvaduṣṭā niśāmyanti | api tu bhagavann adyaprabhṛty ahaṃ tathāgatasya purataḥ pratijñāṃ kariṣyāmi |
analyzed: saṃkṣobhayanti ati vṛṣṭim anāvṛṣṭim akāla vṛṣṭim pātayanti api tu bhagavat maitrī vihāriṇā vidyādhareṇa mantra vādinā bhavitavyam maitrī sattva saṃnāhena bhavitavyam maitrī khaḍga hastena bhavitavyam maitryā sarva duṣṭāḥ niśāmyanti api tu bhagavan adya prabhṛti aham tathāgatasya puratas pratijñām kariṣyāmi

original: yatrāyaṃ vidyādhararājā pracariṣyati na tatra bhagavan bhūyo nāgā upadravaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ | yatrāyaṃ hṛdayadhāraṇī rakṣāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ sīmābandhaṃ maṇḍalabandhaṃ pratisarāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ tasya vayaṃ bhagavan satatasamitaṃ sarvopadravān nivārayiṣyāmaḥ |
analyzed: yatra ayam vidyādhara rājā pracariṣyati na tatra bhagavan bhūyas nāgāḥ upadravam kariṣyāmaḥ yatra ayam hṛdaya dhāraṇī rakṣāyām kṛtāyām paritrāṇam parigraham paripālanam sīmābandham maṇḍalabandham pratisarāyām kṛtāyām tasya vayam bhagavan satata samitam sarva upadravān nivārayiṣyāmaḥ

original: [1.9] atha bhagavāṃs teṣāṃ nāgādhipatīnāṃ sādhukāram adāt | sādhu sādhu bhujagādhipatayaḥ | evaṃ yuṣmābhiḥ karaṇīyam | surakṣitair yuṣmābhir jambudvīpam anurakṣitavyam iti |
analyzed: atha bhagavān teṣām nāga adhipatīnām sādhukāram adāt sādhu sādhu bhujaga adhipatayaḥ evam yuṣmābhiḥ karaṇīyam su rakṣitaiḥ yuṣmābhiḥ jambudvīpam anurakṣitavyam iti

original: [1.10] athāta upacāravidhiṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakarmakaraṃ śubham | sasyapīḍākāle kṣubhanti | tadā vidyādhareṇa kṣetramadhye ’raṇye vā caturasraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kartavyam | catvāraḥ pūrṇakumbhāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ | puṣpāvakīrṇaṃ kartavyam | sapta rūpakavalayaḥ kartavyāḥ | taṇḍulavalayaḥ |
analyzed: atha atas upacāra vidhim pravakṣyāmi sarva karmakaram śubham sasya pīḍā kāle kṣubhanti tadā vidyādhareṇa kṣetra madhye raṇye vā catur asram maṇḍalakam kartavyam catvāraḥ pūrṇa kumbhāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ puṣpa avakīrṇam kartavyam sapta rūpaka valayaḥ kartavyāḥ taṇḍula valayaḥ

original: ekaikarūpakam ekaviṃśatirūpakaṃ kartavyam | bhaktapāyasakṛsaradadhikṣīraṃ saṃsthāpayitavyam | phalapuṣpaṃ sthāpayitavyam | catvāro ghaṭikāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ | saktupramukhā mahābalipūrvaṃ sthāpayitavyā | madhye maṇḍalake kuṇḍaṃ sthāpayitavyam | pañcagavyaṃ kṣīram udakaṃ pūrayitavyam | sarṣapalājā prakṣeptavyā |
analyzed: eka eka rūpakam ekaviṃśati rūpakam kartavyam bhakta pāyasa kṛsara dadhi kṣīram saṃsthāpayitavyam phala puṣpam sthāpayitavyam catvāraḥ ghaṭikāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ saktu pramukhāḥ mahā bali pūrvam sthāpayitavyāḥ madhye maṇḍalake kuṇḍam sthāpayitavyam pañcagavyam kṣīram udakam pūrayitavyam sarṣapa lājā prakṣeptavyā

original: ṣaṣṭivārān mantraḥ parijaptaḥ khadirakīlakāni catvāri ayomayāni | ekakīlakam aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ kartavyam | caturṣu koṇeṣu maṇḍalakasya kapilagomayā catvāro nāgāḥ kartavyāḥ | khadirakīlakā ca hṛdayasthā sakalaṃ nikhantavyam | aṣṭottaraśataṃ mantraṃ parijaptavyam | pūrvasyāṃ saptaśīrṣakaṃ nāgaḥ sthāpayitavyaḥ |
analyzed: ṣaṣṭi vārān mantraḥ parijaptaḥ khadira kīlakāni catvāri ayaḥ mayāni eka kīlakam aṣṭa aṅgula pramāṇam sarveṣām kartavyam caturṣu koṇeṣu maṇḍalakasya kapila gomayā catvāraḥ nāgāḥ kartavyāḥ khadira kīlakā ca hṛdaya sthā sakalam nikhantavyam aṣṭottaraśatam mantram parijaptavyam pūrvasyām sapta śīrṣakam nāgaḥ sthāpayitavyaḥ

original: paścimāyāṃ diśi aṣṭaśīrṣakam | dakṣiṇasyāṃ pañcaśīrṣakam | uttarasyāṃ triśīrṣakam | madhye maṇḍale navaśīrṣako nāgaḥ sthāpayitavyaḥ | catvāro dhūpakaṭacchukāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ | pañcamo madhyamaṇḍale | lājāsarṣapamiśrena ekaviṃśati vārān parijapya caturdiśaṃ prakṣeptavyāḥ | iyaṃ dhāraṇī likhya caturṣu maṇḍalakoṇeṣu dhvajāgre ’varopayitavyāḥ |
analyzed: paścimāyām diśi aṣṭa śīrṣakam dakṣiṇasyām pañca śīrṣakam uttarasyām tri śīrṣakam madhye maṇḍale nava śīrṣakaḥ nāgaḥ sthāpayitavyaḥ catvāraḥ dhūpa kaṭacchukāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ pañcamaḥ madhya maṇḍale lājā sarṣapa miśrena ekaviṃśati vārān parijapya caturdiśam prakṣeptavyāḥ iyam dhāraṇī likhya caturṣu maṇḍala koṇeṣu dhvaja agre varopayitavyāḥ

original: kṣetramadhye ca sthāpayitavyāḥ | ārāmamadhye ca sthāpayitavyāḥ | sahasthāpitamātreṇa samantāc caturdiśaṃ mahāparvataprāgbhārasīmābandhaḥ kṛto bhavati |
analyzed: kṣetra madhye ca sthāpayitavyāḥ ārāma madhye ca sthāpayitavyāḥ saha sthāpita mātreṇa samantāt caturdiśam mahā parvata prāgbhāra sīmābandhaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati

original: [1.11] yāvat kīlakaṃ noddhriyate tāvat mahāsīmābandho bhavati | sarvasasyāni sarvapuṣpaphalāni svārakṣitāni bhaviṣyanti | antaśa ekapatram api na śuṣyanti | kiṃ punaḥ śākhāntāḥ śuṣyanti | sarvaprāṇakajātayaḥ mṛgapakṣī tāni sarvāṇi tuṇḍe bandhaṃ bhaviṣyati | na śakyaṃ vināśayitum | naṣṭā te ’pi punar api tejāḥ pratilabhante |
analyzed: yāvat kīlakam na uddhriyate tāvat mahā sīmābandhaḥ bhavati sarva sasyāni sarva puṣpa phalāni su ārakṣitāni bhaviṣyanti antaśas eka patram api na śuṣyanti kim punar śākhā antāḥ śuṣyanti sarva prāṇaka jātayaḥ mṛga pakṣī tāni sarvāṇi tuṇḍe bandham bhaviṣyati na śakyam vināśayitum naṣṭā te pi punar api tejāḥ pratilabhante

original: punar api balapuṣṭitejā upasaṃkrāmanti | sa ca kuṇḍaṃ
analyzed: punar api bala puṣṭi tejāḥ upasaṃkrāmanti sa ca kuṇḍam

original: [2.14] atha samantākāracchatrākaraparikaro mahānāgarājā utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya tripradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavantaṃ nānāpuṣpair gandhamālyavilepanābharaṇavastraiḥ pūjayām āsa | pūjayitvā purato niṣaṇṇaḥ |

original: [2.15] atha catvāro mahārājāno yena bhagavāṃs tenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantam etad avocat | atidāruṇāni bhagavan mahābhayāni loke utpannāni | yad utānāvṛṣṭidurbhikṣakāntārāḥ | anayā bhagavan vyasanayā sarvasattvā atrāṇā aśaraṇā abhūvan |
analyzed: atha catvāraḥ mahā rājānaḥ yena bhagavān tena añjalim praṇamya bhagavantam etat avocat ati dāruṇāni bhagavat mahā bhayāni loke utpannāni yat uta anāvṛṣṭi durbhikṣa kāntārāḥ anayā bhagavan vyasanayā sarva sattvāḥ atrāṇāḥ aśaraṇāḥ abhūvan

original: bhagavāṃs tathārūpān mantrapadān bhāṣantu yena paścime kāle paścime samaye nānāvyasanasaṃnipāto lokaṃ samuttāraṇāya |

original: [2.16] atha bhagavān vaiśravaṇaṃ mahārājaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ mahārājaṃ virūḍhakaṃ mahārājaṃ virūpākṣaṃ ca mahārājam etad avocat | asti mahārājan samantajvalitavidyun nāma saṃcodanīhṛdayadhāraṇīmantrapadā yena sahaśravaṇamātreṇa sarvanāgabhavanāni sarvanāgaśarīrāṇi jvalitāni bhaviṣyanti | sarvaduṣṭanāgahṛdayāni kṣubhyanti |
analyzed: atha bhagavān vaiśravaṇam mahā rājam dhṛtarāṣṭram mahā rājam virūḍhakam mahā rājam virūpākṣam ca mahā rājam etat avocat asti mahā rājan samantajvalitavidyut nāma saṃcodanī hṛdaya dhāraṇī mantra padā yena saha śravaṇa mātreṇa sarva nāga bhavanāni sarva nāga śarīrāṇi jvalitāni bhaviṣyanti sarva duṣṭa nāga hṛdayāni kṣubhyanti

original: sarvanāgaśīrṣāṇi saptadhā sphuṭitāni bhaviṣyanti | akṣimūrdhāni sphuṭanti | khaṇḍakhaṇḍāni viśīryante | tān mahārājāno gṛhṇata duṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ nāśanārthāya sarvasattvānāṃ paripālanārthāya |
analyzed: sarva nāga śīrṣāṇi saptadhā sphuṭitāni bhaviṣyanti akṣi mūrdhāni sphuṭanti khaṇḍa khaṇḍāni viśīryante tān mahā rājānaḥ gṛhṇata duṣṭa praduṣṭānām nāśana arthāya sarva sattvānām paripālana arthāya

original: [2.17] atha catvāro mahārājāno bhagavataḥ pādayor nipatyaivam āhuḥ | bhāṣatu bhagavan samantajvalitavidyun nāma saṃcodanīnāgahṛdayadhāraṇīmantrapadān |

original: [2.18] atha bhagavān nāgāvalokitena sarvatathāgatāvalokitena vyavalokya sarvanāgaparṣan saṃnipātyaivam āha | śṛṇvantu ime bhujagādhipataye dhāraṇīmantrapadān |
analyzed: atha bhagavān nāgāvalokitena sarva tathāgata avalokitena vyavalokya sarva nāga parṣan saṃnipātya evam āha śṛṇvantu ime bhujaga adhipataye dhāraṇī mantra padān

original: tadyathā | oṃ vipulapravare | nāge mahānāge nāgahṛdayāvarte | jvala jvala sarvanāgahṛdayāni | kimi kimi | nāgakulavidhvaṃsani | hana hana sarvaduṣṭanāgahṛdayāni | daha daha sarvanāgabhavanāni | paca paca pācaya pācaya sarvaduṣṭanāgānām | ākrama ākrama sarvasamudrasāgaravimalavikrame mahānāgatejavare svāhā |
analyzed: tat yathā om vipula pravare nāge mahā nāge nāga hṛdaya āvarte jvala jvala sarva nāga hṛdayāni kimi kimi nāga kula vidhvaṃsani hana hana sarva duṣṭa nāga hṛdayāni daha daha sarva nāga bhavanāni paca paca pācaya pācaya sarva duṣṭa nāgānām ākramaḥ ākrama sarva samudra sāgara vimala vikrame mahā nāga teja vare svāhā

original: [2.19] sahabhāṣitamātrayā bhagavatā anayā nāgahṛdayadhāraṇīmantrapadayā atha te sarvanāgā tharatharāyamānā mlānaklinnadurgandhakāyāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ | agnijvālā iva saṃdahyamānāḥ | paritaptam uccasvareṇa bhagavantam ākrandaṃ kurvanto bhagavantam evam āhuḥ | atidāruṇāni bhagavan mantrapadāni bhāṣitāni | sarvam asmākaṃ hṛdayāni viheṭhyanti |
analyzed: saha bhāṣita mātrayā bhagavatā anayā nāga hṛdaya dhāraṇī mantra padayā atha te sarva nāgāḥ tharatharāyamānāḥ mlāna klinna durgandha kāyāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ agni jvālāḥ iva saṃdahyamānāḥ paritaptam ucca svareṇa bhagavantam ākrandam kurvantaḥ bhagavantam evam āhuḥ ati dāruṇāni bhagavat mantra padāni bhāṣitāni sarvam asmākam hṛdayāni viheṭhyanti

original: anupālayiṣyāmaḥ | satyapratijñena sthāpayiṣyāmaḥ | ekaputravat sarvasattvān anupālayiṣyāmaḥ | yatra yatraiva bhagavan pṛthivīpradeśe ’yaṃ vidyādhararājā pracariṣyati tatra tatra vayaṃ bhagavan sarvasāmagrībhāvena vihariṣyāmaḥ | smaraṇamātrayāpi bhagavan nitya vidyārājā vayaṃ sarve varṣadhārā-mutsṛjāmaḥ | smaraṇamātreṇāpi ativṛṣṭiṃ nivārayāmaḥ |
analyzed: anupālayiṣyāmaḥ satya pratijñena sthāpayiṣyāmaḥ eka putra vat sarva sattvān anupālayiṣyāmaḥ yatra yatra eva bhagavan pṛthivī pradeśe yam vidyādhara rājā pracariṣyati tatra tatra vayam bhagavan sarva sāmagrī bhāvena vihariṣyāmaḥ smaraṇa mātrayā api bhagavat nitya vidyārājā vayam sarve varṣa dhārām utsṛjāmaḥ smaraṇa mātreṇa api ati vṛṣṭim nivārayāmaḥ

original: nivārayatha | mā vināśatha | tatas te bhujagādhipatayo nirupadravāḥ paścime kāle paścime samaye vihariṣyatheti | yadi samyag eva bhujagādhipatayaḥ samayaṃ nānurakṣatha | tenāhaṃ bhujagādhipatayo nāparādhya iti |
analyzed: nivārayatha mā vināśatha tatas te bhujaga adhipatayaḥ nirupadravāḥ paścime kāle paścime samaye vihariṣyatha iti yadi samyak eva bhujaga adhipatayaḥ samayam na anurakṣatha tena aham bhujaga adhipatayaḥ na aparādhye iti

original: [3.14] prathamanāgasaṃcodanavidyā |
analyzed: prathama nāga saṃcodana vidyā

original: [3.15] athāto mūlavidyāyā upacāraṃ pravakṣyāmi nāgānāṃ cittasammatam | anayā jvalitagaruḍatejohṛdayadhāraṇyā parijapya meghamaṇḍali prathamataram ākāśaṃ vyavalokya śarṣapalājāmiśraṃ caturdiśaṃ kṣeptavyam | sarvameghāśani stambhitā bhaviṣyanti | sarvanāgās tharatharāyamānās tiṣṭhanti | bhasmodakam ekaviṃśati vāraṃ parijapyābhiṣicyātmarakṣā kṛtā
analyzed: atha atas mūlavidyāyāḥ upacāram pravakṣyāmi nāgānām citta sammatam anayā jvalita garuḍa tejaḥ hṛdaya dhāraṇyā parijapya megha maṇḍali prathamataram ākāśam vyavalokya śarṣapa lājā miśram caturdiśam kṣeptavyam sarva megha aśani stambhitāḥ bhaviṣyanti sarva nāgāḥ tharatharāyamānāḥ tiṣṭhanti bhasma udakam ekaviṃśati vāram parijapya abhiṣicya ātma rakṣā kṛtā

original: bhaviṣyati | sarṣapam aṣṭottaraśataṃ parijapya meghagarjanakāle sapta vārān pānīyaṃ parijapya tataḥ sarṣapam ākāśe kṣeptavyam | sa ākāśe meghabandhaṃ dātavyam | meghābhimukhaṃ sarvapuṣpaphalaṃ gṛhītaṃ dharaṇyāṃ patanti | mantrānusmārayitavyam | kruddhena phaṭkāro dātavyaḥ | tribhiḥ phaṭkārair nāgā adhomukhāḥ patanti |
analyzed: bhaviṣyati sarṣapam aṣṭottaraśatam parijapya megha garjana kāle sapta vārān pānīyam parijapya tatas sarṣapam ākāśe kṣeptavyam saḥ ākāśe megha bandham dātavyam megha abhimukham sarva puṣpa phalam gṛhītam dharaṇyām patanti mantra anusmārayitavyam kruddhena phaṭkāraḥ dātavyaḥ tribhiḥ phaṭkāraiḥ nāgāḥ adhomukhāḥ patanti

original: nāgaśarīrāṇy api viśīryante sthale patanti |
analyzed: nāga śarīrāṇi api viśīryante sthale patanti

original: dāḍimalatām ekaviṃśati vārān parijapya cakrākāraṃ sapta vārān bhrāmayet | sarvaduṣṭanāgāḥ śītavātameghāśaniyo dharaṇyāṃ patanti | saptadhā mūrdhānaḥ sphuṭanti | akṣīn sphuṭanti | sakalasāmantameghā nāgāḥ saparivārā aṣṭottaraśatayā kruddhena bhrāmitayā dharaṇyāṃ patanti |
analyzed: dāḍima latām ekaviṃśati vārān parijapya cakra ākāram sapta vārān bhrāmayet sarva duṣṭa nāgāḥ śīta vāta megha aśaniyaḥ dharaṇyām patanti saptadhā mūrdhānaḥ sphuṭanti akṣīn sphuṭanti sakala sāmanta meghāḥ nāgāḥ sa parivārāḥ aṣṭottaraśatayā kruddhena bhrāmitayā dharaṇyām patanti

original: sakalanāgabhavanaṃ sajalaṃ savṛkṣavanaṣpataya ekajvālībhūtā bhavanti | sarve ca mahānāgarājā mahaujaskā maharddhikā mahatā śīrṣarogena grastā bhavanti | yadi vidyādharaḥ śīghraṃ mantrāpayati sarveṣāṃ kulonmādo bhavanti | saputrapautrāḥ saparṣan savāhanā vinaśyanti | vilayaṃ yāsyanti | sarṣapān sahasravārān parijapyānāvṛṣṭikāle bhavane kṣeptavyam |
analyzed: sakala nāga bhavanam sa jalam sa vṛkṣa vanaṣpatayaḥ eka jvālībhūtāḥ bhavanti sarve ca mahā nāga rājāḥ mahā ojaskāḥ maharddhikāḥ mahatā śīrṣa rogena grastāḥ bhavanti yadi vidyādharaḥ śīghram mantrāpayati sarveṣām kula unmādaḥ bhavanti sa putra pautrāḥ sa sa vāhanāḥ vinaśyanti vilayam yāsyanti sarṣapān sahasra vārān parijapya anāvṛṣṭi kāle bhavane kṣeptavyam

original: sarve ca nāgā tharatharāyanti | ekajvālībhūtaṃ bhavanasaro bhaviṣyanti | śīghraṃ varṣadhārā-m-utsṛjanti | yathākāmataḥ punaḥ punar varṣadhārā-m-utsṛjanti |
analyzed: sarve ca nāgāḥ tharatharāyanti eka jvālībhūtam bhavana saraḥ bhaviṣyanti śīghram varṣa dhārām utsṛjanti yathākāmatas punar punar varṣa dhārām utsṛjanti

original: yadā varṣaṇa kāryaṃ tadā vidyādhareṇa sarṣapodakenāṣṭottaraśataṃ parijapya uccasthānam āruhya pūrvābhimukhena sthitvā pūrvasyāṃ diśi sapta udakāñjalayaḥ kṣeptavyāḥ saptavārān mantraṃ parijapya sadya sarvanāgarājāna †eka madhye† saṃnipatanti | varṣadhārā-m-utsṛjanti |
analyzed: yadā varṣaṇa kāryam tadā vidyādhareṇa sarṣapa udakena aṣṭottaraśatam parijapya ucca sthānam āruhya pūrva abhimukhena sthitvā pūrvasyām diśi sapta udaka añjalayaḥ kṣeptavyāḥ sapta vārān mantram parijapya sarva nāga rājānaḥ madhye saṃnipatanti varṣa dhārām utsṛjanti

original: aruṇakāle sarṣapakuṅkumodakaṃ sammiśraṃ saptavārān parijapya caturdiśaṃ kṣeptavyam | adha ūrdhvaṃ ca kṣeptavyam | sarvaśītavātameghāśanīnāṃ samantād yojanaṃ sīmābandho bhaviṣyati | sarvaduṣṭanāgā baddhā
analyzed: aruṇa kāle sarṣapa kuṅkuma udakam sammiśram sapta vārān parijapya caturdiśam kṣeptavyam adhas ūrdhvam ca kṣeptavyam sarva śīta vāta megha aśanīnām samantāt yojanam sīmābandhaḥ bhaviṣyati sarva duṣṭa nāgā baddhā

original: bhaviṣyanti | anatikramaṇīyāḥ sarvanāgā bhaviṣyanti | kapilagomayam apatitaṃ gṛhītvā tasyā eva ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ gomūtraṃ gṛhya saptabījakam †āḍham† miśret | tanmantreṇa navativārān parijapya tato pañcaśīrṣako nāgaḥ kartavyaḥ | phaṇimaṇino baddhaparyaṅkaḥ parivartitaḥ śvetacandanakuṅkumena lepya śucyāsane sthāpayitavyaḥ | paṭṭābhiṣekaḥ kartavyaḥ |
analyzed: bhaviṣyanti an atikramaṇīyāḥ sarva nāgāḥ bhaviṣyanti kapila gomayam a patitam gṛhītvā tasyāḥ eva ghṛtam kṣīram go mūtram gṛhya sapta bījakam āḍham miśret tad mantreṇa navati vārān parijapya pañca śīrṣakaḥ nāgaḥ kartavyaḥ phaṇi maṇinaḥ baddha paryaṅkaḥ parivartitaḥ śveta candana kuṅkumena lepya śuci āsane sthāpayitavyaḥ paṭṭābhiṣekaḥ kartavyaḥ

original: puṣpamālāṃ dātavyam | saptarasikā kumbhavalayaḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ | dadhikṣīrataṇḍulakṣurasaśarkarāmākṣikaṃ phalapuṣpaṃ tatraiva kṣeptavyam | caturasraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kartavyam | puṣpāvakīrṇaṃ kartavyam | catvāraḥ pūrṇakumbhāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ | catvāraḥ śarā nikhantavyāḥ | catasraḥ śvetapatākā bandhayitavyāḥ | baliṃ madhyamaṇḍalake sthāpayitavyaḥ |
analyzed: puṣpa mālām dātavyam sapta rasikā kumbha valayaḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ dadhi kṣīra taṇḍula kṣu rasa śarkarā mākṣikam phala puṣpam tatra eva kṣeptavyam catur asram maṇḍalakam kartavyam puṣpa avakīrṇam kartavyam catvāraḥ pūrṇa kumbhāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ catvāraḥ śarāḥ nikhantavyāḥ catasraḥ śveta patākāḥ bandhayitavyāḥ balim madhya maṇḍalake sthāpayitavyaḥ

original: catvāraḥ khadirakīlakā caturṣu koṇeṣu maṇḍalasya nikhantavyāḥ | pañcaraṅgikena sūtreṇa pañcavartikena vartayitavyam | sarvatra ekaviṃśati vārān parijapya karma kartavyam | kumbhaśirasi ghaṇṭā bandhayitavyam | naladaṃ sarjarasaṃ kundurukaṃ nakhaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ gaurasarṣapaṃ śarkarā saha yojyam | mantreṇāṣṭaśataṃ japtena kartavyam |
analyzed: catvāraḥ caturṣu koṇeṣu maṇḍalasya nikhantavyāḥ pañcaraṅgikena sūtreṇa pañcavartikena vartayitavyam sarvatra ekaviṃśati vārān parijapya karma kartavyam kumbha śirasi ghaṇṭā bandhayitavyam naladam sarjarasam kundurukam nakham nāgapuṣpam gaurasarṣapam śarkarā saha yojyam mantreṇa aṣṭaśatam japtena kartavyam

original: tena dhūpo dātavyaḥ | eṣa dhūpaḥ sarvatra prayoktavyaḥ | tato vidyādhareṇa susnātena śucivastradhāriṇā bhavitavyam | etenaiva mantreṇa
analyzed: tena dhūpaḥ dātavyaḥ eṣa dhūpaḥ sarvatra prayoktavyaḥ tatas vidyādhareṇa su snātena śuci vastra dhāriṇā bhavitavyam etena eva mantreṇa

original: upaspṛśanaśikhābandhasīmābandhamaṇḍalabandhanaṃ vastrotkṣepanaṃ ātmarakṣā snānaṃ kartavyam | nāgaṃ pūrvāmukhaṃ sthāpya vidyādhareṇa tadabhimukhaṃ niṣadya tenaiva mantreṇāvāhanabalipuṣpadhūpavisarjanaṃ kartavyam | tato vidyādharenāṣṭottarasahasraṃ japtavyam | ekaikaṃ sarṣapaṃ phalaṃ parijapya nāgapratimā hantavyāḥ | catvāraḥ ghṛtapradīpo dātavyāḥ |
analyzed: upaspṛśana śikhābandha sīmābandha maṇḍalabandhanam vastra utkṣepanam ātma rakṣā snānam kartavyam nāgam pūrvāmukham sthāpya vidyādhareṇa tad abhimukham niṣadya tena eva mantreṇa āvāhana bali puṣpa dhūpa visarjanam kartavyam tatas vidyādharena aṣṭottarasahasram japtavyam ekaikam sarṣapam phalam parijapya nāga pratimāḥ hantavyāḥ catvāraḥ ghṛta pradīpaḥ dātavyāḥ

original: nāgānāṃ saṃsthātavyāḥ | yasyāvāhayati sa upatiṣṭhati | pūrṇe aṣṭottarasahasrajāpena sarve mahānāgarājāno vaśyā bhavanti | sarvadā darśanaṃ dāsyanti | yathābhiprāyaṃ tat sarvaṃ dāsyanti | sarvaṃ ca vistareṇa prakārayanti | sarvasvajanaparivārāḥ saputrapautrā vaśyā bhavanti |
analyzed: nāgānām saṃsthātavyāḥ yasya āvāhayati saḥ upatiṣṭhati pūrṇe aṣṭottarasahasra jāpena sarve mahā nāga rājānaḥ vaśyāḥ bhavanti sarvadā darśanam dāsyanti yathā abhiprāyam tat sarvam dāsyanti sarvam ca vistareṇa prakārayanti sarva sva jana parivārāḥ sa putra pautrāḥ vaśyāḥ bhavanti

original: sarvakarmakarā bhavanti | yathā svagṛhavat paripālayanti |
analyzed: sarva karmakarāḥ bhavanti yathā sva gṛha vat paripālayanti

original: [3.16] pañcanāgakanyārūpaṃ guhyasthāne sthāpayitavyam | puṣpadhūpaṃ dātavyam | nirākule dhārayitavyam | aprakaṭaṃ na kasyacid darśanaṃ dātavyam | śucivastreṇa cchādayitavyam | yadā kāryaṃ bhavati sarṣapenāṣṭaśatajaptena hantavyam | sarvakāryāṇi kariṣyati | yatra preṣayati tatra gacchati | punar apy āgacchati | svapne sarvaṃ kathayati |
analyzed: pañca nāga kanyā rūpam guhya sthāne sthāpayitavyam puṣpa dhūpam dātavyam nirākule dhārayitavyam aprakaṭam na kasyacid darśanam dātavyam śuci vastreṇa chādayitavyam yadā kāryam bhavati sarṣapena aṣṭaśata japtena hantavyam sarva kāryāṇi kariṣyati yatra preṣayati tatra gacchati punar api āgacchati svapne sarvam kathayati

original: yathākāryaṃ sarvakarmakaro bhaviṣyati | nāgapreṣaka iti kathyate | yadākālameghavātāśaniśītā bhaviṣyanti tadā caṇḍabījakaṃ sarṣapamiśram
analyzed: yathākāryam sarva karmakaraḥ bhaviṣyati nāga preṣakaḥ iti kathyate yadā akāla megha vāta aśani śītāḥ bhaviṣyanti tadā caṇḍa bījakam sarṣapa miśram

original: ekottaraśataṃ parijapya kruddhena nāgarūpaṃ tāḍayitavyam | tatkṣanāt sarvavātāśani vinaśyanti | sarve baddhā bhaviṣyanti | anāvṛṣṭikāle mantra cīrikāṃ likhya raktasūtreṇa veṣṭayitvā ekaviṃśati granthiṃ kṛtvā nāgapratimākaṇṭhe bandhayitavyam | nāgamūrdhāv ekaviṃśati vārān parijapitavyam | tatkṣaṇād varṣadhārā-m-utsṛjanti | yāvad icchayā varṣanti |
analyzed: ekottaraśatam parijapya kruddhena nāga rūpam tāḍayitavyam tad kṣanāt sarva vāta aśani vinaśyanti sarve baddhāḥ bhaviṣyanti anāvṛṣṭi kāle cīrikām likhya rakta sūtreṇa veṣṭayitvā ekaviṃśati granthim kṛtvā nāga pratimā kaṇṭhe bandhayitavyam nāga mūrdhau ekaviṃśati vārān parijapitavyam tad kṣaṇāt varṣa dhārām utsṛjanti yāvat icchayā varṣanti

original: ativṛṣṭikāle nīlasūtrakaṃ sapta vārān parijapya sapta granthayaḥ kartavyāḥ | ativṛṣṭiṃ prakramiṣyanti | anyāni ca sarvatra kalpavidyāsādhanam | pūrvokta eṣa mantraḥ | pūrvatara sapta vārān anusmārayitavyam | sarvatraiva prayujyate | paṭhitena sarvatra sādhanam iti sidhyati |
analyzed: ati vṛṣṭi kāle nīlasūtrakam sapta vārān parijapya sapta granthayaḥ kartavyāḥ ati vṛṣṭim prakramiṣyanti anyāni ca sarvatra kalpavidyā sādhanam pūrva uktaḥ eṣa mantraḥ pūrvatara sapta vārān anusmārayitavyam sarvatra eva prayujyate paṭhitena sarvatra sādhanam iti sidhyati

original: [3.17] mahāgaruḍavegavajravegajvālitagaruḍahṛdayamaṇḍalī nāma dhāraṇī samāptā |
analyzed: mahāgaruḍavegavajravegajvālitagaruḍahṛdayamaṇḍalī nāma dhāraṇī samāptā

original: [4.1] athāto mūlahṛdayasyopacāravidhir bhaviṣyati | sahoccāritamātrayā sarvanāgās tharatharāyante | vāraṇī vātameghasya dāḍimalatayā karavīralatayā vā dhārayitavyam uccaśarasi | apatitagomayena maṇḍalakaṃ kartavyaṃ caturasraṃ suvibhaktaṃ svabhāgataḥ | aṣṭau khadirakīlakān aṣṭāṅgulapramāṇān nikhanet | daśasu diśāsu caturṣu koṇeṣu nikhanet |
analyzed: atha atas mūlahṛdayasya upacāra vidhiḥ bhaviṣyati saha uccārita mātrayā sarva nāgāḥ tharatharāyante vāraṇī vāta meghasya dāḍima latayā karavīra latayā vā dhārayitavyam ucca śarasi a patita gomayena maṇḍalakam kartavyam catur asram su vibhaktam sva bhāgataḥ aṣṭau khadira kīlakān aṣṭa aṅgula pramāṇān nikhanet daśasu diśāsu caturṣu koṇeṣu nikhanet

original: śarapañcakaṃ triśūlaṃ ca nikhanet | catvāri śare pañcaraṅgikasūtreṇa samantāta pariveṣṭayitavyāḥ | catvāraḥ pūrṇakumbhāḥ | catvāro dhūpakaṭacchakāḥ | catvāra eva balikumbhāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ | śuklabalipūrṇakaṃ madhyamaṇḍale sthāpayitavyāḥ | puṣpāvakīrṇaṃ ca kārayet | lājāsarṣapam avakiret | sarve saptasaptavārān parijapya nikhantavyāḥ |
analyzed: śara pañcakam triśūlam ca nikhanet catvāri śare pañcaraṅgika sūtreṇa samantāt pariveṣṭayitavyāḥ catvāraḥ pūrṇa kumbhāḥ catvāraḥ dhūpa kaṭacchakāḥ catvāraḥ eva bali kumbhāḥ sthāpayitavyāḥ śukla bali pūrṇakam madhya maṇḍale sthāpayitavyāḥ puṣpa avakīrṇam ca kārayet lājā sarṣapam avakiret sarve sapta sapta vārān parijapya nikhantavyāḥ

original: sarṣapodakaṃ parijaptena caturdiśaṃ sīmābandhayet | mahān sīmābandho bhavati | samantena yojanaṃ tatra duṣṭanāgā na śaknuvanti avataritum | mahānāgā evaṃ sadā na śaktā akālaśītavātameghāśaniṃ nipātayitum | na ca hiṃsayituṃ na śaktāḥ | tṛṇapatram api kadācana | sarve baddhā bhaviṣyanti | pañcabandhanapīḍitāḥ |
analyzed: sarṣapa udakam parijaptena caturdiśam sīmā ābandhayet mahān sīmābandhaḥ bhavati samantena yojanam tatra duṣṭa nāgāḥ na śaknuvanti avataritum mahā nāgāḥ evam sadā na śaktāḥ akāla śīta vāta megha aśanim nipātayitum na ca hiṃsayitum na śaktāḥ tṛṇa patram api kadācana sarve baddhāḥ bhaviṣyanti pañca bandhana pīḍitāḥ

original: aṣṭamāsikam evaṃ tu sīmābandho bhaviṣyati | na yakṣā na ca bhūtāś ca rākṣasāḥ pretakumbhāṇḍāś ca guhyakāḥ | anatikramanīya saṃsthānam | tato vidyādhareṇa maṇḍalakamadhye sthitvā dāḍimalatayā saptajaptayā nāgā vārayitavyāḥ | nātikrūraṃ vārayitavyam | nāgaparyaṅkamudrā bandhayitavyāḥ | tarjanī phaṇiśiraḥ kartavyam | kanīyasīṃ tu prasārayet |
